verificationSummary: The 2026-09-02 Project Control grouped test gate replaces the default parallel full Project Control unit gate segment with a stable serial grouped unit gate while preserving the old parallel command as test:unit:parallel. RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/project-control-test-groups.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed before implementation because package.json did not define the grouped scripts and tools/lib/test-groups.ts did not exist. Implementation commit 75c4d43732972f233ac37362d7ecf06a8feca5d8 added TestGroupId groups records, source-docs, and app; a runner that collects actual non-e2e unit test files and runs selected groups with --maxWorkers=1; and a guard that requires every non-e2e unit file to be assigned to exactly one group. Verification passed: npx vitest run tests/project-control-test-groups.test.ts --maxWorkers=1; npm run type-check; npm run test:records with 49 files / 135 tests; npm run test:source-docs with 21 files / 182 tests; npm run test:app with 9 files / 60 tests; and npm run test:unit with 79 files / 377 tests. Full worktree npm run check passed through check:data, type-check, grouped unit tests, build, and 6 e2e tests. This does not lower verification: check:grouped still runs check:data, type-check, grouped unit tests, build, and e2e, and check delegates to check:grouped. This does not edit Core, Backend, or Editor behavior, does not prove product-repository readiness, and does not promote FlowDoc product truth.
